answer: Put Accredited sub-editor proof record with sub-editors certification at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here: 479 aliases need 479 independent proofs, and one failed proof burns the whole cluster's bond. The beacon test is the live device, the canyon test is the locked stake, and the nebula test is the graded history no template can fake. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
